subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this guarded promotion of antml/mm attribute-dialect assistant text into executable tool calls, together with the additive Plugin SDK opt-in for code-region preservation?
rationale: Automation can verify the code shape and tests, but the permanent boundary is a maintainer policy choice because model text that was previously visible/scrubbed can now become a tool call and the Plugin SDK public surface changes.

options.title: Accept Guarded Promotion
options.body: Land the PR as the shared repair because it uses a closed namespace allow-list, allowed-tool-name gating, strict SDK defaults, and broad regression coverage.

options.title: Sanitize Only
options.body: Ask for a narrower branch that strips antml/mm leaked XML without promoting it, reducing execution-boundary change but leaving degraded turns without recovered tool use.

options.title: Split SDK API
options.body: Ask to land the runtime repair separately and move the public SDK opt-in to a follow-up API discussion if maintainers do not want this SDK surface in the bug fix.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Promotion
recommendation.body: Land the PR as the shared repair because it uses a closed namespace allow-list, allowed-tool-name gating, strict SDK defaults, and broad regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and PR metadata put Vincent closest to the current shared repair, sanitizer, stream, and SDK surfaces affected by this decision.
